name: MyD Delivery
author: Eduardo Villão

sections.description:
MyD Delivery was built for restaurants, cafés, bakeries, dark kitchens, and any local business that wants a fast and simple way to sell online — without paying marketplace fees or dealing with complex e-commerce setups.

You get a full delivery system running 100% inside WordPress, fully under your control.

Why MyD Delivery?

  • No marketplace fees – keep 100% of every order.
  • No WooCommerce required – standalone system, nothing extra to install.
  • Quick setup – start receiving orders in minutes.
  • Mobile-friendly checkout – your customers order easily from their phone.
  • Lightweight & independent – no external services, all data stays on your site.

Key Features (Free)

  • Unlimited products and categories
  • Orders management dashboard
  • Customer data storage
  • WhatsApp order sending with customizable message
  • Mobile-friendly checkout
  • Extra product options (add-ons, combos, etc.)
  • Mercado Pago and Pagar.me payment integrations
  • Country-based configs (currency, price format, and more)
  • Reports

Premium Add-ons

Extend MyD Delivery with official add-ons when your business needs more.

MyD Maps — Distance-based delivery fees without a Google Maps API key. Set rules once and let the math handle pricing for every order. No more flat fees that eat your margins.

MyD Notifications — Automatic WhatsApp notifications at every order status change. Confirmed, preparing, out for delivery, delivered — your customer’s phone gets a message, your staff does nothing extra. Powered by the official Meta Business API.

Learn more at myddelivery.com
sections.installation:
1. Install directly from the WordPress plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access MyD Delivery in your WordPress admin menu to configure your products and delivery settings.
  4. (Optional) Connect your WhatsApp number to receive orders instantly.
sections.faq:
Do I need WooCommerce to use MyD Delivery?

No. MyD Delivery is a standalone system — nothing extra required. Install, activate, and you’re ready to go.

Does it work with WooCommerce?

MyD Delivery runs independently of WooCommerce. If you’re looking for delivery notifications on a WooCommerce store, check out MyD Notifications, which also works with Order on Mobile for WooCommerce.

Can I send orders directly to WhatsApp?

Yes. Customers place their order and you receive it via WhatsApp for fast confirmation. You can fully customize the message content.

What are MyD Maps and MyD Notifications?

They are official premium add-ons for MyD Delivery. MyD Maps adds distance-based delivery fee calculation. MyD Notifications sends automatic WhatsApp status updates to customers at every stage of the order. Both are available as monthly subscriptions at myddelivery.com.

Where can I get support?

Documentation, tutorials, and support are available at myddelivery.com.
